mechanism.claim: In a high-variation completed Asia session, BTC direction confirmed by at least five of six major alt perpetuals while the median absolute alt move exceeds BTC is broad speculative overshoot; fade BTC for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of BTC completed-session return
mechanism.why_distinct: AFGI uses price-free alt taker-flow geometry and a fitted learner; DCRM/LORE use cross-alt residual rankings and alt pairs; PFCR uses funding ranks and an alt pair. CABER uses only contemporaneous cross-alt price breadth and magnitude to trade directional BTC, with no flow, funding, volume, residual, model, or prior control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed BTC session realized-variation strict-prior rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one daily 08:05 UTC six-alt breadth exhaustion clock is distinct from Gross9 source clocks

features.session: exact bars_binance 1m paths [00:00,08:00) UTC; all 480 timestamps required for every symbol
features.returns: log(07:59 close/00:00 open) independently per symbol; BTC return strict nonzero
features.breadth: at least five of six alt return signs equal the strict nonzero BTC sign; zero alt returns do not confirm
features.exhaustion: median of six absolute alt returns > absolute BTC return, strict inequality
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared BTC 1m log(close/open)) over completed session
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 270 previous valid sessions; minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.availability: 08:00 UTC after all seven exact paths complete

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent cross-alt breadth-exhaustion mechanism plus user-required high volatility

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no breadth, magnitude, session, side, hold, timing, volatility, or subset repair
